import parse

# What about exact match mode?
p = parse.compile('{:<}')
result1 = p.parse('hello')
print(f"parse hello: {result1}")

result2 = p.parse('hello ')
print(f"parse 'hello ': {result2}")

result3 = p.parse('hello world')
print(f"parse 'hello world': {result3}")

# Now search
result4 = p.search('hello')
print(f"search hello: {result4}")

result5 = p.search('hello ')
print(f"search 'hello ': {result5}")

result6 = p.search('hello world')
print(f"search 'hello world': {result6}")
PYEOF
